# Rainberry — *Friendship is Magic* (G4)

**Who is she?** A small, pale mint-green **unicorn filly** with a red/coral-and-orange striped mane, blue eyes, and **blue mane-and-tail bows**. She is easiest to spot beside the similarly styled adult unicorn **Rainbow Stars**, her apparent older-sister partner at Ponyville's Sisterhooves Social. This is a genuine character design seen in the G4 television series, though **“Rainberry” is a fan/community name**, not a verified name spoken on screen. [Rainbow Stars character and scene record](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Rainbow_Stars).

**Names and voice.** The name *Rainberry* appears as an **unofficial placeholder** in the fandom's foal catalog; no original coiner or Hasbro naming source could be verified. [Foal identification and appearance list](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Foals?page=1). A fan review also calls this filly **“Blue Ribbon”**; treat that as alternative fan usage, *not* an established official alias. [Contemporary fan commentary](https://www.fimfiction.net/blog/855968/the-point-of-no-return-review-how-guilt-can-mess-with-your-perception). She participates in an operatic vocal duet but has **no verified individually credited speaking role or voice actor**; do not confuse her with Rainbow Stars, who has later credited dialogue.

**Where to see her.** Her debut is **“Brotherhooves Social” (S5E17)**, partnering Rainbow Stars in the Sisterhooves Social. She subsequently appears in **“A Hearth's Warming Tail” (S6E8)**, **“Flutter Brutter” (S6E11)**, **“The Ending of the End – Part 2” (S9E25)**, and **“The Last Problem” (S9E26)**. These later sightings are brief background appearances.

**Show still — Rainberry at left, Rainbow Stars at right.** Production: *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic* (Hasbro/DHX); image preserved; the image links to its contextual Twibooru post.

[![Rainberry and Rainbow Stars at the Sisterhooves Social](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/2020/7/14/762800/medium.png)](https://twibooru.org/762800)

## Important moments

1. **Joining the Sisterhooves Social — “Brotherhooves Social” (S5E17).** Rainberry appears as Rainbow Stars' junior partner, giving the otherwise unnamed filly her most identifiable relationship and setting. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8ngtTehVTz4) (**scene timestamp unavailable**).
2. **Singing together — “Brotherhooves Social” (S5E17).** The pair deliver a brief **operatic duet** before the featured competitors perform, the closest Rainberry gets to a vocal spotlight. [Episode narrative and competition context](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Brotherhooves_Social) (**scene timestamp unavailable**).
3. **Delivering newspapers — “Flutter Brutter” (S6E11).** Her short paper-delivery appearance offers a glimpse of ordinary life beyond the fair; she has no plot-changing dialogue. [Episode information](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Flutter_Brutter) (**scene timestamp unavailable**).

*Continuity:* Rainberry is **visible in the official G4 TV continuity**; the name and possible alternate label are **fandom identifications**, not proven in-universe names. The Sisterhooves Social accepts non-sisters too, so her biological relationship to Rainbow Stars is **suggested rather than explicitly established**.
